verdict.rationale: The evidence supports the general claim. The official repo says ROS spans 'from drivers to state-of-the-art algorithms', the base install ships message packages, and topics are meant for streaming sensor data. Community users add that many existing nodes and drivers are a main reason to stay on ROS 2, and that its shared, widely agreed datatypes make integration easier. However, nothing names specific camera, lidar, IMU or GPS drivers, or the standard sensor message types. Missing for 10: documentation of standard sensor message types (e.g., image, laser scan, IMU, GNSS fix), named ready-made drivers for each of the four sensor classes, and hands-on corroboration of bringing up real sensors.
